title: 收音机调谐回路
statement: 收音机输入回路可等效为 RLC 串联电路：线圈电感 L = 0.5 mH，线圈电阻 R = 5 Ω，C 为可调电容。天线感应到某电台信号 V̇_s = 1∠0° mV（有效值），角频率 ω = 10⁶ rad/s。
调节 C 使回路对该电台谐振。求所需的 C、谐振时回路电流 I、电容电压 V_C 的有效值和相位（相对于 V_s）。

questions.ask: 使回路在 ω = 10⁶ rad/s 谐振，C 应调到多少？
questions.explain: 谐振条件 ωL = 1/(ωC)：C = 1/(ω²L) = 1/(10¹² × 0.5 × 10⁻³) = 2 × 10⁻⁹ F = 2 nF。此时 X_L = X_C = 500 Ω；下一问的电流 I = V_s/R 正说明回路确实处于谐振。

questions.ask: 谐振时回路电流有效值 I = ?
questions.explain: 谐振时 Z = R = 5 Ω，I = 1 mV / 5 Ω = 0.2 mA。
V_C = I·X_C = 0.2 mA × 500 Ω = 0.1 V = 100 mV，是天线信号的 Q = ω₀L/R = 500/5 = 100 倍。
谐振时电流与 V_s 同相；电容电压滞后电流 90°，所以 V̇_C = −j100 mV，相位 −90°。

hints: 谐振时 X_L = X_C，先算 X_L = ωL，再由 X_C = 1/(ωC) 求 C。
谐振时 Z = R，I = V_s/R；V_C = I·X_C = Q·V_s。
solution: **2. 电流。** 谐振时 Z = R = 5 Ω（最小），I = 1 mV/5 Ω = **0.2 mA**，与 V_s 同相。
**4. 品质因数。** Q = ω₀L/R = 500/5 = 100 = V_C/V_s。串联谐振把微弱的电台信号“放大”了 100 倍送到后级；其他频率的电台不谐振，阻抗大得多，电流和 V_C 都很小——这就是谐振回路的选择性，Q 越高选择性越好。

en.title: Radio tuning circuit
statement: The input circuit of a radio is modelled as a series RLC circuit: coil inductance L = 0.5 mH, coil resistance R = 5 Ω, and a variable capacitor C. The antenna picks up a station's signal V̇_s = 1∠0° mV (rms) at ω = 10⁶ rad/s.
C is adjusted so that the circuit resonates with this station. Find the required C, the loop current I at resonance, and the rms value and phase (relative to V_s) of the capacitor voltage V_C.

questions.ask: To resonate at ω = 10⁶ rad/s, what must C be set to?
questions.explain: Resonance: ωL = 1/(ωC), so C = 1/(ω²L) = 1/(10¹² × 0.5 × 10⁻³) = 2 × 10⁻⁹ F = 2 nF. Then X_L = X_C = 500 Ω; the current in the next question, I = V_s/R, confirms that the circuit really is at resonance.

questions.ask: rms loop current at resonance I = ?
questions.explain: At resonance Z = R = 5 Ω, so I = 1 mV / 5 Ω = 0.2 mA.
V_C = I·X_C = 0.2 mA × 500 Ω = 0.1 V = 100 mV, which is Q = ω₀L/R = 500/5 = 100 times the antenna signal.
At resonance the current is in phase with V_s, and the capacitor voltage lags the current by 90°: V̇_C = −j100 mV, phase −90°.

hints: At resonance X_L = X_C: compute X_L = ωL first, then find C from X_C = 1/(ωC).
At resonance Z = R, I = V_s/R, and V_C = I·X_C = Q·V_s.
solution: **1. Tuning capacitor.** X_L = ωL = 10⁶ × 0.5 × 10⁻³ = 500 Ω. Resonance needs X_C = 500 Ω: C = 1/(ωX_C) = 1/(10⁶ × 500) = **2 nF**.
**2. Current.** At resonance Z = R = 5 Ω (minimum), I = 1 mV/5 Ω = **0.2 mA**, in phase with V_s.
**3. Capacitor voltage.** V̇_C = −jX_C·İ = −j500 × 0.2 mA = −j0.1 V: rms value **100 mV**, phase **−90°**.

**4. Quality factor.** Q = ω₀L/R = 500/5 = 100 = V_C/V_s. Series resonance 'amplifies' the weak station signal 100 times for the next stage; other stations are off resonance, see a much larger impedance and produce a far smaller current and V_C — that is the selectivity of a resonant circuit, and the higher Q, the better it is.
